definitions.explanation: The seat(s) in the back of a vehicle, especially a car. Distinguished from the front passenger seat and the driver's seat.

examples.japanese: {後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit in the back seat.

examples.japanese: {後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シートベルト→シートベルト：29083_shiitoberuto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{締|し}めて→締める：10057_shimeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make sure to fasten your seatbelt in the back seat as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せて→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧、チャイルド⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please have children ride in the back seat and use a child seat.

notes:
A compound of {後部|こうぶ} (rear part) and ⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧ (seat). Primarily used for car seating but can also apply to buses and airplanes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シートベルト→シートベルト：29083_shiitoberuto⟧: back seat seatbelt
- {後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride in the back seat
- {後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧: back seat passenger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: the seat in the back — more casual and everyday expression
- ⟦{助手席|じょしゅせき}→助手席：14738_joshuseki⟧: front passenger seat — the seat next to the driver
- ⟦{運転席|うんてんせき}→運転席：16777_untenseki⟧: driver's seat

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, wearing seatbelts in the {後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき} became mandatory on all roads in 2008. In taxis, VIP passengers typically sit in the {後部|こうぶ}{座席|ざせき}, with the seat directly behind the driver considered the most prestigious position.
